a.lede: After months of inconsistent pricing, Intel's Core i7-14700K is down to its lowest price ever at $249.99, with support for LGA 1700 motherboards that come with either DDR4 or DDR5 memory support.
a.title: Act fast to score Intel's Core i7-14700K for its lowest price ever at $249.99

b.lede: AMD's king of gaming CPUs, the Ryzen 7 9850X3D, is down to its lowest price ever at $399 ahead of Black Friday.
b.title: AMD's top-performing Ryzen 9850X3D is now the same price as the 9800X3D, an all-time low
